mainEntity.name: Do I need a special permit to build a tiny home rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building a tiny home rental unit almost always requires permits. These typically include building permits, zoning permits, and potentially specific permits for utility connections (electrical, plumbing, sewer/septic). The exact permits needed depend on local municipal codes, the classification of the tiny home (e.g., ADU, manufactured home), and whether it's on a foundation or wheels. It is crucial to consult your local planning and building departments early in the process to understand all necessary requirements and avoid potential legal issues.
